lede: Detroit Lions carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#6 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Miami Dolphins +4.0 with a fair total of 49.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Detroit Lions pass offence vs Miami Dolphins pass defence, which sits +0.408 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Detroit Lions and Miami Dolphins have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
